scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Complete classification applies only over an algebraically closed field of characteristic two to the primitive integer monomial-orbit model with a and e invertible. Eklund uses differently scaled generators, so naive mod-two reduction of his basis is NOT this spread. General 12-node and central 6-A3 cases of q^2+xyzw are already known from Catanese and Schuett III, Example 19; the claimed contribution is the intermediate parameter-wall ADE and finite flat length-24 scheme classification with explicit birational Cremona dual of degree twelve. Independent audit has not been performed. Specialized equivalent presentations could exist.
title: The flat length-24 singular scheme and Cremona dual of primitive Heisenberg quartics in characteristic two
